notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/b5e2b8658969223913812b05ce4610940dc3bf71.png[/img]
Hey guys!

We're finally here with the long-awaited Spring Update!

This update brings a bunch of new CGs created by Animetix, the lovely studio that created the opening animation.

We have also been working on a unique new feature for the game, but unfortunately it couldn't make it into this update. (though please look forward to it!)

Hopefully, these beautiful new CGs will make up for it! (If you've already played the game, they should already be unlocked in the gallery)

Here's a short list compiling what's new in this update:

[list]
[*] Added MULTIPLE new CGs
[*] Gallery now includes new CGs
[*] Updated credits
[*] Fixed some typos and grammar issues
[/list]

If you have feedback or bugs that you'd like to let us know about, OR want to meet more yuri fans, you can join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/aVxXJZSWny

Thank you guys for continuing to support us! <3

notes.title: Visual Novel Fest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/470bd78bd4b3cfb82f622be58fed6877280a3349.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

Scarlet Defiance: The Wall Between Us is participating in the Visual Novel Fest! This means that our game AND bundle will be on sale for 20% off. If you haven't already bought them now's a great deal.

Along with this, we're happy to announce that some new updates will be coming next week for the Spring Sale!

Stay tuned next week for an official update announcement!

In the meantime, tell your friends and fellow yuri enthusiasts.

Happy Yuri-ing!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/a614a1d9e6b83785aaef57094ea23efc377c1724.png[/img]
Hey guys!

We've been working on a lot of stuff, but wanted to release some updates now so that you guys can experience them!

Here's a list of the additions and changes that will be in this update:

[list]
[*] Added new CGs and backgrounds
[*] Gallery now includes new CGs, and you can also view acquired BGs
[*] Added achievements
[*] Released an original soundtrack available for purchase on the Steam store page
[*] Updated credits
[*] GUI update
[/list]

We plan to have a major update for the Visual Novel festival in March 2025 as well, so please stay tuned!

If you have feedback or bugs that you'd like to let us know about, you can join our discord here: https://discord.gg/aVxXJZSWny

Thank you guys for continuing to support us <3

notes.title: Thank You! + Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/049fec6473c674b9d988dc8679e82bcc793cccee.png[/img]

Hey guys!

Thank you so much for your support so far. It makes all of these sleepless nights worth it for us in the end. We still have a lot of work to do though!

We've been reading all of your comments and reviews on our game! We'd like to hear feedback on what you guys would have liked to see more of.

There's still a lot of things we'd like to polish and change, and we were thinking about ways to increase the immersion in certain key scenes in the game.

In the coming weeks, here's what we have planned:
[list]
[*] UI improvements
[*] BGM and audio adjustments
[*] Achievements
[*] An original soundtrack release
[*] New BG images
[/list]
In the meantime, you remember those guys that got their hands blown off by Sofia in the opening trailer? Here's the concept art for them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/688af78b17fd14ceafb7bf24b07de36960aef262.png[/img]

We hope to continue to have your support in the future!

notes.title: Now Released!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wdiqxH17HQo
Hey guys!

We're so glad to finally have been able to release this game! Thank you to everyone that's supported us and helped spread the word! 

However, this isn't all...

We're planning to polish the game even more to ensure the best player experience! There's still a few things we have left to tweak. Please stay tuned for future updates and announcements regarding the game. :)

Who knows, there could possibly be a sequel in the works...

Please follow Sofia and Vlatka's journey until the end! There is so much more to their story that we'd love to share.

Once again, thank you guys so much for your support. We hope to see you around!

P.S. The game is compatible with Steam deck!

To stay up to date with us, you can follow us on social media here:
[url=https://x.com/vmmersion]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/aVxXJZSWny]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@vmmersionstudios]YouTube[/url]

notes.title: Official Game Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/82bb3e54dbdd0d44dfdeee6fe90b05e454d2002d.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We're very excited to announce that the full game will be releasing on November 13th, 2024 at 12:00PM EST!

However, this doesn't mean that the game will stop updating. We'll do our best to optimize your experience with the game and keep adding on to the game until it's absolutely perfect!

The full game will include a full English VA cast, text localizations in Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Spanish.

Thank you so much for all of the support thus far. 

Please look forward to the release of the game!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/8ed8e5950a2ace906f763374534f90ccd18ea597.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

As announced before, today's update will add some exciting things to the demo!

This update will include:
[list]
[*] Voice acting for EVERY SINGLE CHARACTER (in English)!!
[*] New sprite additions for Iulian Dascalu, Garridan Răzvan Zugrăvescu, Agata Agapov, Mihai Stanislav, and Lord Stanislav.
[*] Minor grammar fixes
[*] More SFX added
[*] Slight adjustments to some sentences that were phrased a bit oddly
[*] Text Localizations in Japanese, simplified/traditional Chinese, and Spanish
[*] Talking and blinking animations for all sprites

[/list]

We hope you guys enjoy it!

notes.title: Upcoming Update & News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/1ba70da913ba649ee5a7f8b8284b9e839c16cfa9.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Apologies for the recent bout of inactivity in our social media! We've been working on some big things behind the scenes.

We're so excited to let you guys know that the demo for Scarlet Defiance: The Wall Between Us is going to receive a major update soon within the month of September, which includes all of the following:

[list]
[*] Every character is now voiced (in English)
[*] New sprite additions
[*] Minor grammar fixes
[*] More SFX
[*] Slight adjustments to some sentences that were phrased a bit oddly
[*] Localizations in JP, CN, and ES
[/list]

Additionally, we have a huge announcement to make! We'll be attending Tokyo Game Show (9/26 - 9/29) as well to spread the word overseas. We'll be holding a raffle at the end of each day to win an exclusive prize for attendees, as well as showcasing the newest version of our demo!

For anyone coming, we hope to see you there! Thank you for all the support so far!

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/797a000982d3ab4c17315b99c08123e7ca5fee92.png[/img]
Scarlet Defiance: The Wall Between Us's first official demo is now released on Steam and available for download!

We hope you enjoy our hard work in developing this game, and hope to read your thoughts and feedback on how we can strive for an amazing full release!

This demo is estimated to be about 30min - 1 hour long with 2 chapters from the official game, featuring some of the songs in our original soundtrack!

If you'd like to follow our game's updates and official announcements, you can follow our Twitter @vmmersion, and join our discord at discord.gg/aVxXJZSWny! Of course, we'll also be posting announcements and news here on the Steam page as well.

Once again, thank you for your support and please enjoy it to the fullest!

notes.title: Official Demo Release Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923685/b3f5f943e66a58ba948a2d7c3df6a7d07ad2c199.png[/img]
We're excited to announce that we finally have a date for our [b]public demo release![/b]

Mark your calendars! Our yuri visual novel will have an official demo released on [b]Monday, June 24th at 12pm EST![/b]

For those of you that got a chance to play an earlier version of our demo at PAX, this one will be much more different, with an updated story! We've also [b]added 2 new character sprites[/b] for characters we've included in our new demo (no spoilers here!)

We hope you guys enjoy it!
